declared.summary: Close SDK 11/C#15 source and package-risk AUDIT after RS325 independent Verification; document thirteen assessed, three physical closures and ten gaps, then ready only C02 RED.
declared.value: RS325 succeeded first-pass on attempt 001 under DWF 0.1.72, independently verifying ten received Math evidence inputs and three SHA-pinned private Standard/Expression/Quantities archives. Its original physical validator rejected modified archive bytes, a forged version, falsified RS254 first-pass history and an unsupported all-thirteen qualification claim, then accepted restored copies. C01's existing primary-source delta matrix accounts for thirteen source libraries, sixteen source edges, eleven test projects and nine unqualified historical API candidates; only three packages have a bounded Windows net11 locked-consumer proof. Complete T2 Verification, T2 and C01 as an evidence AUDIT with three separate achievements. Admit C02, first migration task and its RED as ready only. The user verified guidance upgrade to 0.27 on a direct docs/workflow-only commit; production SDK and NuGet archives remain untouched.
